description: Milestone 1: Format Spec — complete type definitions (44 types), pure math interpolation engine (easing, lerp, spring, color), Zod validation schemas with AI-readable errors and YAML parsing
Milestone 2: Engine Resolves Frames — resolveFrame(), resolveDelta(), DocumentBuilder fluent API, overlap validation, preset expansion, unit resolution

Milestone 3: First Rendered Frame — Canvas 2D renderer with RenderContext interface, shape/text renderers, fill/stroke styles (solid + gradient), transform stack with anchor points, percentage unit resolution at render time

Milestone 4: AI Creates Animations — MCP server with 25 tools across 7 categories (document, layer, shape, state, delta, preset, preview), in-memory document store, structured error responses, full end-to-end workflow support
Milestone 5: Playback + CLI — CLI tool with validate/info/still commands, playground Vite app with canvas playback (play/pause/scrub), demo animation using DocumentBuilder

Milestone 6: States & Templates — StateMachine class with tick/transition/seek/reset/playThrough, template variable substitution ({{var}} patterns with type preservation), 2 new MCP tools (instantiate_template, find_variables)

22-document documentation suite: root README rewrite, 9 package/app READMEs, format spec, architecture, MCP reference, builder guide, state machine guide, rendering pipeline, getting started, examples catalog, contributing guide, design decisions (10 ADRs), glossary (38 terms), AI agent guide

New @atelier/studio package: reusable editor widget with three view modes (preview, yaml, editor). Includes canvas+playback panel, layer sidebar, property inspector, delta editor, and syntax-highlighted YAML viewer. Integrated into showcase app with view toggle buttons. Updated getting-started.md with showcase run instructions.

Add inline delta editor — clicking a delta header expands an editor with property-matched controls (SliderInput for opacity, ColorPicker for colors, NumberInput for numeric props), property dropdown to change animated property, EasingPicker, and range inputs. Only one delta expanded at a time. New deltas auto-expand. All changes mutate delta directly and fire onDeltaChange for live canvas updates.

Drag-to-reorder for layers and deltas — shared enableDragReorder() utility with HTML5 DnD, MutationObserver handle binding, accent drop indicators; layer panel grip handles with Z-order reordering; delta panel grip handles with flat-array index mapping for per-layer reorder

Add dual-thumb range slider for frame range visualization, optional delta name field with header display, and sort-by-start-frame button to delta panel. Add name?: string to Delta type and DeltaSchema.
Add mini timeline bar to collapsed delta view — non-interactive visual segment showing frame range position relative to animation duration

Add strokeStart/strokeEnd (0–1) trim path animation support across the full stack: types, schema, canvas rendering (setLineDash + lineDashOffset simulation), effective layer resolution, property panel UI sliders, delta panel, and MCP tools. Includes perimeter calculation helpers for rect, ellipse, and path shapes.

Added `atelier render` command — renders animation documents to MP4 or GIF via FFmpeg. Core render pipeline (render-pipeline.ts) handles frame loop, FFmpeg spawning, backpressure, and image preloading. Commander wrapper (render.ts) provides CLI UX with progress display and error messages.
